name: instagram-caption-only
notes: TICKET-209: measures ONE-CHANNEL recall. Instagram never carries a platform transcript (instagramPerception's transcript is always ''), so after TICKET-209 every IG import whose video download flaked arrives as a caption-ONLY body: no [video text] section at all. This fixture is SYNTHETIC (a realistic IG caption shape, real Lisbon venues) — it exists to prove that the caption channel alone still yields full recall and that the video OCR noise block, which is suppressed when has_video_text is false, is not silently required for extraction to work. fail_on_extras is on: an enumerated caption is complete ground truth, and the trailing hashtag/mention block (stripped by buildVideoFusion before this text is built) must not reappear as venues.
